business.what_it_does: Balsamiq lets teams go from rough wireframe to interactive prototype without writing code, using AI speed plus human judgment to iterate, align, and decide what to build.

facts.statement: Balsamiq is one fast, focused place to wireframe, prototype, and get aligned before anyone builds.

provenance.quote: Balsamiq is one fast, focused place to wireframe, prototype, and get aligned before anyone builds. Solo or team, first product or internal tool, it's where you decide what's worth building and how.

facts.statement: Balsamiq connects to Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible tools via the Balsamiq MCP server, to read, edit, and build on Balsamiq projects.

provenance.quote: Read, edit, and build on your Balsamiq projects with Claude, Cursor, or other MCP-compatible tools. Use the Balsamiq MCP server to improve your wireframes, generate user stories, write a QA plan, surface missing edge cases, or generate production code.

facts.statement: Balsamiq optimizes prompts in the background to get better results from AI credits.

provenance.quote: We optimize your prompts in the background so you get better results and more out of every AI credit.

facts.statement: Balsamiq is trusted by teams including PostHog, OpenAI, GitLab, Zapier, Nvidia, Databricks, PwC, and GoodRx.
